description: Global data on levelized cost of electricity generation (LCOE) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Levelized cost of electricity database developed by Govinda Timilsina, Sr. Economist, Development Research Group This database is the result of the following study: Timilsina, Govinda R. (2020). “Demystifying the Costs of Electricity Generation Technologies”. World Bank Policy Research Working Paper, WPS 9303. World Bank Washington, DC. Coverage: 187 countries in East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 2 files in XLS, HTML. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
